fields.narrative_intro: *A squirming person and a drenched person discuss SWE-2 at a mandatory AI sensitivity training session for robots.*
fields.panel1:
[setup]
SQUIRMING PERSON: "Cognition's SWE-2 scores 50.0% on FrontierCode 1.1 Main."
DRENCHED PERSON: "Within one point of Fable 5.1—and 64% cheaper."
fields.panel2:
[build]
DRENCHED PERSON: "It's post-trained from 2.8-trillion-parameter Kimi K33."
SQUIRMING PERSON: "Reinforcement learning spans every reasoning-effort level in one run."
fields.panel3:
[pivot]
SQUIRMING PERSON: "SWE-2 medium takes 58% fewer turns, costing 81% less than SWE-1.7."
DRENCHED PERSON: "Excellent—our sensitivity circle requires taking turns."
fields.panel4:
[silent reaction]
[Visual: A tiny robot has removed 58% of the chairs and faces the wall; three reasoning dials spin around it. The circle now has one chair.]
fields.panel5:
[punch]
SQUIRMING PERSON: "It calls the missing chairs unnecessary exploration."
DRENCHED PERSON: "It explored one chair, then optimized empathy into a CLI flag."
fields.panel6:
[button]
[Visual: SWE-2 rolls itself like a carpet toward doors marked Devin Web and Fusion, avoiding every turn; one robot applauds from the lone chair.]

narrative_summary: SWE-2's efficiency claims make a robot sensitivity circle literally eliminate turns, chairs, and exploration before rolling out to Devin Web and Fusion.
story_title: Cognition launches new SWE-2 model, Rivaling Fable 5.1 and GPT-Astra
place: at a mandatory AI sensitivity training session for robots
hat_pair: foam stopwatch worn as a flat round hat with a giant sweeping second hand on top
